claim_en: REGIONS APART. Head and beard never combine or share spread; by Heaven's hands only; only scall impurity there.

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Section 5 5-6 + Chapter 8 5-9
claim_en: BLACK HAIR SAVES. Gold-form yellow; the dak dispute; the rescue sign; intake-release; the nested-scall containment flip.
THE GAUGE RULE. Shave around with anything, even the nazirite; leave two hairs as the spread-detector; plucking signs is a Torah violation.
THE TRUTH GATE. The office cannot invert the fact — Hillel's ascent on this matter; proxy eyes; latching purity.

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 10 2; 5-8 + Chapter 11 1-3
claim_en: THE BALD SPOTS. The crown's slope divides two regions; two signs, no white hair, two weeks, at the bean; whole-head scall pure.

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 12 1-14 + Onkelos Lev 13:45
claim_en: THE DECREED LEPER. Loosed and rent (man only, even a high priest); the doubled warning cry in Onkelos; alone — no second impure; three camps out.
